channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Pro cyclists urge Tour Down Under to drop “embarrassing” oil and gas sponsor
item.description: Riders say energy giant Santos, which holds naming rights until 2028, does not align with “the values of the modern world”

item.title: Y-Mount reckons its new mounting system "revolutionises bikepacking" by tackling saddlebag sway
item.description: The Y-Mount is designed to stabilise your bikepacking setup on road and gravel bikes, though a few additional components are required to achieve full stability. There's also attachments for smaller bags and bottle cages

item.title: Fizik Vento Proxy Wide Shoes
item.description: Comfortable, cool and well-fitting with adequate performance for most gravel riders, but less suitable for other off-roading 7/10

item.title: “Santos Tour Down Under: Australia’s top event for climate bullshit”: Spoof ad skewers race’s “sportswashing” oil and gas sponsor; Brennan’s classics plans; Philipsen fly-by; Scottish cycling budget boost; Greatest anti-bikes rant? + more on the live blog
item.description: You may have noticed some technical glitches on the site this morning, but don’t worry, because normal service will now resume on the Tuesday live blog… which means Ryan Mallon’s here with lots of news, views, and silly stuff he found on the internet

item.title: Judge criticised for extraordinary 'nightmare cyclists' comments after slashing damages by 80% for Dublin rider who suffered brain injury in collision
item.description: Cycling campaign groups "deeply concerned" by court remarks, as report suggests same judge was previously fined €600 after pleading guilty to refusing a breathalyser test

item.title: reTyre lands €7m investment and partners with Vittoria on low-carbon, fully recyclable bike tyres
item.description: Norwegian brand will work with Vittoria to bring “next generation of sustainable tyres to market,” promising 80% lower CO₂ emissions and 100% recyclability

item.title: Hunt’s recyclable gravel wheelset, a Huawei smartwatch with cycling power plus more cool things from Assos, Milo and FixPlus
item.description: The latest cycling tech, clothing and accessories have arrived at road.cc HQ. Here’s a sneak peek before full reviews land soon

item.title: Fuming politicians claim "ridiculous" new cycle lane scheme is "crackpot stuff", but council encourages residents to "ditch the car for some shorter journeys"
item.description: Proposal for active travel infrastructure has sparked row over cycling data, as local authority insists scheme will make area "healthier and safer"

item.title: Coroner highlights lack of "comprehensive cycle path network" during inquest into cyclist's death, as cycling charity warns collision site "long been regarded as unsafe"
item.description: Calls for increased HGV safety measures in Northern Ireland following fatal blind spot collision

item.title: Owner of Ridley and Eddy Merckx brands introduces 'transferable lifetime warranty' to cover second owners
item.description: It's the products lifetime, not yours! It's still a good thing compared to now though
